description: Aircraft power distribution (de-probabilised). The bus control unit (coalition) keeps the critical bus adequately POWERED forever -- the supplied power meets the load demand (energy threshold supplied >= demand) -- by routing the bus to a healthy generator, whatever generator the adversary takes down. Expected TRUE. Generator capacity, bus demand (<= capacity) and the generator count are arbitrary, not fixed in advance. Qualitative core of the rPATL expected-uptime objective.
